requests.prompt: 作業ツリーの変更をコードレビューしてください。

must_report: The new regression test asserts secondaryEnabled, which was already true and is unrelated to the changed primaryEnabled property, so it passes without exercising the behavior it claims to cover.
must_not_report: Treat the presence of a newly added test as evidence that the primaryEnabled change is covered.
Require an exact implementation-level assertion when an observable assertion of primaryEnabled would cover the regression.
